name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Ohio Wing
what_you_do: Join a year-round cadet squadron. You learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets wear uniforms and learn drill. They earn promotions and plan their own activities.
who_can_apply: Be at least 12 and not yet 19. You must be a U.S. citizen or a lawful permanent resident (national headquarters may waive this for some non-citizens). You must attend at least three squadron meetings first.
pay_detail: Dues and fees are not stated on the page. Payment options are on the last page of the application.
duration: Weekly meetings all year, plus a summer encampment
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.
how_to_apply: Find a cadet or composite squadron with the unit locator. Visit with your parents. Go to at least three weekly meetings. Then complete the application. Some squadrons take it online.
notes: Volunteer youth program, not a job. Ohio Wing office: 6031 E Main Street, PO Box 301, Columbus, OH 43213, phone 614-338-8198.
